rationale: The translation preserves the exact rectangular dimensions, zero-based-to-one-based prefix indexing, residual signs, transpose placement, ordinary inverse semantics, all three subtracted residual contributions, and the quadratic term. Its expanded equality is algebraically equivalent to both lines of the paper display. The only substantive difference is that it removes the paper's global CGS-P execution, rank, triangularity, positivity, floating-point, and smallness context and quantifies arbitrary matrices satisfying the operative exact equations. Since every paper instance remains covered and no source conclusion is weakened, the result is faithful but strictly stronger.
